episodes.title: This Will Be Us
episodes.summary: After an abrupt end to her ghost-hunting training, Lucy Carlyle flees to London — where she meets two teens who run a paranormal investigative agency.

episodes.title: Let Go of Me
episodes.summary: After a job goes up in flames, Lockwood is given two weeks to come up with £60,000 in damages. Lucy uses the ring to communicate with the spirit.

episodes.title: Doubt Thou the Stars
episodes.summary: Hoping to pay back their debt, the team takes on a job for an unexpectedly high-profile client. But the task proves more treacherous than they imagined.

episodes.title: Sweet Dreams
episodes.summary: While the team is working to clear up a volatile grave at a cemetery, Lucy hears a voice speak her name. Ghosts aren't supposed to talk... are they?

episodes.title: Death Is Coming
episodes.summary: The team scrambles to locate a missing relic before their rival agents do. Deep in the ghost-hunting underworld, danger lurks around every corner.

episodes.title: You Never Asked
episodes.summary: The jarred skull leads Lucy to Bickerstaff's home. The team accepts an invite to the Fittes ball, hoping to snag a rare book from the company library.

episodes.title: Mesmerised
episodes.summary: With George and Flo on standby, Lucy and Lockwood infiltrate a black market auction where members of the underworld will bid on a priceless artifact.

episodes.title: Not the Eternal
episodes.summary: As Lockwood and Lucy uncover the nature of the bone glass, they come to understand that George's life is in danger — and time's running out to save him.
